title: BlockEntryMC
description:
Blocks the IP to access through the Bungeecord.
Compatible with Velocity.
body:
Are you tired of multiaccounts with the same IP?
you don't want to allow so much accounts from the same IP?

You can block the IPs from the Bungee now.
languages: en, es.

Use the command:
/blockentry deny <ip> [reason]

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/850a11c6018b7b363bd8b8e56ac176b7d976b99f.png)

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fd632e98335833715da7df9f2622cbcc77f89716_0.webp)

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/12525415bcba171478e707c90065b8f551f69074.png)

/blockentry allow <ip> (Allow or remove the IP Blocked)

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f3ad5637b421fb8f6e068a20b2b22b89bd34295b.png)

/blockentry reload (reload the config.yml and blocked-ips.dat)

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9a4c0e1e7fa8e107e5951826c895d18e66d96a88.png)

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ca556211ede7f9aedb630cc6fbc69b93ec427ba0.png)

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c415d6f7200f529d53628efa51d49a164c79aa75.png)

The reason is optional, only if you want to note why and what.
